name: blockwright-tools
description: Blockwright: independent tools for Minecraft creators. First tool: Character Builder (player skins + Bedrock custom entities).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API,WORKER -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/minecraft-skin && npm run build -w packages/bedrock-export
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.verify:exports: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && node scripts/verify-exports.mjs
scripts.fixtures: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && node scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs
scripts.dev:manual: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c green,cyan "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
